fights.doc: Fights a lair of this tier takes to clear (18-garrisons-and-raids.md §5): the last at the lair's power, the ones before it ramping up from delve.firstFightPower.

heroXp.doc: Hero XP a lair of this tier teaches, once per lair, split evenly across its fights: each fight won pays its share, the last one with the claim.

rewardItems.doc: Items a lair of this tier puts in the Bag when its prize is claimed.
